_comment: Scheduling metadata for the CRUD scenarios in scenarios.json. Keeps service prerequisites and account quota kinds as DATA so a scheduler can serialize/parallelize lifecycles safely against core.budgets (vpc=5, private-dns=3, ...). 'quota_kinds' maps a lifecycle id -> the capped resource kinds it CREATES (and must reserve in core.budgets before running); a scheduler should serialize lifecycles that share a kind once the live usage + reserved slots reach the limit. 'prerequisites' lists the in-flow resource families each lifecycle stands up before its headline resource (informational: these are created inline by the lifecycle's own steps, not external preconditions). 'budget_paths' maps the create PATH that consumes a kind -> the kind, mirroring engine._budget_kind_for_path so the mapping has one source of truth.
_dag_comment: 1.0-a (scheduler DAG): shared_roots + adopt_edges are DERIVED from the lifecycle adopt steps and VALIDATED by regression.scenarios.validate_dag (--check). adopt_edges[lifecycle]=shared roots it reuses (the DAG edges); shared_roots[root].parent chains them (subnet/subnet#db under vpc). self_creates (cap slot-consumers) are derived live, not stored. Regenerate after adding/removing adopt steps: python -m regression.scenarios.validate_dag --check.

vpc#a._comment: 네트워킹 공유 VPC A (10.130.0.0/20, 오너 설계 2026-07-13) — vpc-peering requester + vpc-subnet-vip-nat(서브넷 10.130.9.0/24 + IGW). CIDR은 peering rule 하드코딩과 일치해야 함 (engine._NET_VPC_A_CIDR).

vpc#b._comment: 네트워킹 공유 VPC B (10.141.0.0/20) — vpc-peering accepter + gen-wave5-fw(IGW 방화벽) + networking-direct-connect-routing(DC, VPC당 1 배타). IGW 소유: A=vip-nat, B=fw — 충돌 없음.

tgw._comment: 공유 TGW (오너 2026-07-13) — 계정 캡 3. vpc-transit-gateway-children만 self-create(TGW+자식 CRUD 주인공), gen-private-nat(private-nat 전제조건)·heavy-shared-networking(순수 커버리지)은 이걸 adopt → 동시 TGW 3→2.

igw._comment: 공유 IGW (오너 2026-07-14) — IGW는 VPC당 1개 배타. 메인 공유 VPC(parent:vpc)에 IGW 1개를 상주시켜 gen-heavy-lb-members·gen-heavy-vs-netops·networking-vpn-gateway-tunnel·gen-pilot-net-basics가 adopt → 각자 create-igw 시 2번째부터 400 already-associated 실패(gen-heavy-lb-members) 해소. IGW create/PUT/delete 커버리지는 net-VPC IGW 소유자(vpc-subnet-vip-nat=A·gen-wave5-fw=B)가 유지.

vpc_schedule._comment: Strategy to keep runs from colliding on the account VPC cap (=5, VALIDATED live: 'The number(5) of VPCs ... exceeded', run 27306490231; per-run cap 4 leaves 1 slot of headroom for leftovers / the A-parallel-B overlap). See knowledge/domain-constraints.md + knowledge/vpc-scheduling-strategy.md. VPCs must NOT overlap CIDRs and a subnet's CIDR must be a sub-range of its VPC's CIDR (see knowledge/domain-constraints.md allocation table). 'per_run_vpc_cap' is the max concurrent live VPCs a single run should hold. In the shared-infra parallel design the shared VPC (1) is torn down BEFORE the serial VPC-CRUD pass, so that pass gets the full cap (e.g. vpc-peering needs 2 at once). 'cross_run_policy' = how to stop concurrent runs from competing for VPCs.
vpc_schedule._classification_comment: Shared-infra parallel design (knowledge/vpc-scheduling-strategy.md). 'adopt_lifecycles' reuse the ONE session-shared VPC+subnet (provisioned once by regression.scenarios.shared_infra --provision; ids passed via SCP_SHARED_VPC_ID/SCP_SHARED_SUBNET_ID env) and create only their own child resource -> safe to run in PARALLEL with pytest-xdist. 'vpc_crud_lifecycles' MUST self-create (their purpose is vpc/subnet/peering creation, they MUTATE the shared vpc, or they need >1 vpc) -> run SERIALLY (xdist -n0) so they stay within per_run_vpc_cap (1 shared + <=1 self-created at a time). shared_infra.py --print-filters derives PARALLEL_K = 'not (<vpc_crud ids OR'd>)' and VPC_CRUD_K = '<vpc_crud ids OR'd>' so the two -k selections partition all enabled CRUD lifecycles with no overlap.
vpc_schedule._net_vpc_comment: 2026-07-13 오너 설계: peering의 두 VPC를 net-A(10.130/20)/net-B(10.141/20)로 상주 프로비저닝(provision, adopt 토큰 vpc#a/vpc#b)하고 vip-nat→A, fw·DC-routing→B가 그 안에서 IGW/DC를 테스트 — IGW(VPC당 1)·DC(VPC당 1) 배타가 A/B 분산으로 해소, 런당 VPC 생성 7→5회. peering/vip-nat/fw/dc-routing은 이제 adopt-class(병렬 안전). 라이브 미검증 1건: 피어링 걸린 VPC 안 IGW/VIP 생성 허용 여부(다음 풀런 판정).
vpc_schedule._priority_first_comment: 오너 지시 2026-07-13 (run Gantt 실측: 예측 58.9분/실제 53.1분 런에서 vpc-subnet-vip-nat가 ~28분, networking-vpc-subnet이 ~40분에야 시작해 런 꼬리를 만듦). 짧은 VPC-슬롯 소비자는 LPT(긴 것 우선) 정렬에서 뒤로 밀리는데, 그때는 슬롯이 장기 점유 중이라 대기까지 겹친다. t=0에는 공유 VPC 1개뿐이라 슬롯이 비어 있으므로 이 목록의 lifecycle을 최우선 투입해 슬롯을 먼저 쓰고 일찍 반납하게 한다. 적용 지점: tests/crud/conftest.py 수집 정렬(실행), local_run.simulate_schedule(예측 Gantt), dag_scheduler.priorities(dag 경로) — 세 곳 모두 schedule_optimizer.load_priority_first()로 이 목록을 읽는다.

fixed_ip_map._comment: ADOPT-class lifecycles re-home their fixed host IPs into the shared subnet (10.124.0.0/24) at DISTINCT, non-overlapping host addresses so two parallel adopters never claim the same IP in the ONE shared subnet. Reserve .1 (gateway). All these steps are optional+broad expect_status so a reject still records coverage.

vpc_schedule.cross_run_policy: Never let two VPC-mutating runs overlap. Preferred: a single shared concurrency group for mutating runs (cancel-in-progress:false) so they queue. Interim: trigger one lane at a time and wait for the prior run's regression job to complete (the reliable 'VPCs no longer being created' signal) before the next. NOT ENFORCED TODAY: .github/workflows/api-test.yml concurrency.group is keyed on github.run_id (per-run), so mutating runs can overlap and leave the account at the 5-VPC cap when the next run's shared-VPC provision fires — a primary contributor to IB-047 (see root_cause below).
vpc_schedule.shared_vpc_adopt: IMPLEMENTED (shared VPC + shared SUBNET, parallel-adopt): the 10 adopt_lifecycles carry {'adopt':'vpc'} on create-vpc/delete-vpc AND {'adopt':'subnet'} on create-subnet/delete-subnet, reusing ONE session-shared VPC (10.124.0.0/20) + ONE shared subnet (10.124.0.0/24) provisioned by engine.provision_shared_vpc. Ids flow via SCP_SHARED_VPC_ID/SCP_SHARED_SUBNET_ID env so every pytest-xdist worker adopts the SAME live infra. ADOPT-class fixed host IPs were re-homed into the shared subnet at distinct addresses (see fixed_ip_map) to avoid collision under parallel runs. Self-create stays as fallback when no shared id is present. The 7 vpc_crud_lifecycles self-create (run serially). See tests/crud/test_shared_vpc_adopt.py + knowledge/vpc-scheduling-strategy.md.
vpc_schedule.durable_fix: Remaining (to make a single un-sharded run fully self-regulating): (1) share ONE core.budgets.Budget across the pytest session and Budget.sync('vpc'/'private-dns', live_count) from a real list call before creates (the pytest driver currently builds a fresh Budget per lifecycle and never syncs, so the reserve gate sees a phantom 5 free); (2) drain-wait on GET /v1/vpcs after a VPC teardown before the next VPC create; (3) reorder so heavy-shared-networking is not last, or rely on (1)+(2). The phantom-5 budget is WORSE under xdist: job A runs pytest -n 6, so each of the 6 worker PROCESSES has its own in-memory Budget — there is no shared accounting across workers even within one run.
vpc_schedule.root_cause_IB047: CONFIRMED (offline analysis, run 27588002895). All 25 enabled VPC-creating lifecycles in CI job A (regression, ADOPT class = PARALLEL_K) ALREADY carry {'adopt':'vpc'} and would adopt the ONE shared VPC if SCP_SHARED_VPC_ID were set — so adopt-fix (a) is DONE at the data level (verified: heavy-shared-dbaas + gen-heavy-pg/epas/mysql/mariadb-replica all have adopt:vpc on create-vpc/delete-vpc). The skip cascade is a PROVISION-FAILURE path, not a missing-adopt path: when the 'Provision shared VPC' step (workflow ~L375, 10x45s retry) cannot win a slot — because cross_run_policy is unenforced and there is NO pre-run stale-VPC reclaim, so the account is already at 5 — SCP_SHARED_VPC_ID is never exported. conftest shared_vpc fixture then takes the xdist-no-env branch and yields {} -> every adopter falls back to SELF-CREATE. Under -n 6 the 6 workers fire POST /v1/vpcs concurrently, instantly saturating the 5-cap; 23/25 then skip at create-vpc:scp-network.vpc.exceed-max-count. So eventstreams/searchengine/vertica/pg-full DBaaS creates never run. NOTE: the *-subops-guarded eventstreams/searchengine/vertica lifecycles have NO create-vpc step (coverage-only, adopt an existing cluster_id); the 'never reached their create' set is the VPC-creating DBaaS chains (gen-heavy-pg-replica = pg-full, gen-heavy-epas/mysql/mariadb-replica, heavy-shared-dbaas's 5 engines).
vpc_schedule.fix_disposition_IB047: (a) extend adopt to DBaaS heavy chains = ALREADY DONE (no edit needed). (b) serialize/cap concurrent VPC self-creates = REQUIRES out-of-scope edits, flagged as HANDOFF: (b1) ENGINE handoff — in regression/scenarios/engine.py make an {'adopt':'vpc'} create step that finds NO shared id ENVIRONMENTALLY SKIP (LifecycleSkip) instead of self-create WHEN running under an xdist worker (PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER set), so a failed provision degrades to 'skip all adopters' (recoverable, no cap trample) instead of a 25-way self-create race; keep the single-process self-create fallback intact (unit test test_no_shared_vpc_falls_back_to_self_create must stay green by gating on the xdist env). (b2) WORKFLOW handoff — drop job A pytest -n 6 toward -n 1..2 for the adopt pass, and/or fail the run loudly if provision yields no id under run_heavy (so the cascade can't silently eat coverage). (b3) WORKFLOW handoff — enforce cross_run_policy: set concurrency.group to a constant 'scp-api-test-mutating' for mutating runs. (c) pre-run stale-VPC reclaim / VPC quota increase = LIVE + owner/console = STOP-1 (do NOT run offline): run cleanup.reconciler (tag-scoped, optionally sweep_force) BEFORE the provision step, or raise the account vpc quota above 5. LATENT LEAK to flag: gen-wave5-fw (generated__wave5.json, out of edit scope) is a job-A lifecycle that self-creates a VPC with NO adopt flag — it burns a slot in parallel with the adopters even when adoption works; add adopt:vpc to its create-vpc/delete-vpc when the generated JSON owner next recomposes.

notes: Quota kinds come from core.budgets.DEFAULT_LIMITS (vpc=5, private-dns=3). networking-dns-hosted-zone (scenarios.json) stays disabled — superseded 2026-06-11 by networking-dns-hosted-zone-private (lifecycles/networking__dns.json), an ADOPT-class heavy lifecycle that declares [vpc, private-dns] (it ADOPTS the shared VPC for the private-dns connect step and self-creates only the private-dns, which the engine budget-gates via POST /v1/private-dns; fallback self-create VPC block 10.142.0.0/20). private-dns provisioning is VERY slow (hours observed) so the lifecycle is heavy and must not have others serialized behind it. The four heavy lifecycles each stand up their own VPC inline, so under the 5-VPC cap a scheduler must serialize them (and the two light VPC lifecycles) rather than run them concurrently. The engine reserves a slot in core.budgets before each /v1/vpcs (and /v1/private-dns) create and releases it on teardown; a multi-process scheduler should first Budget.sync() each kind from a live list call, then gate concurrency on Budget.available(kind). | cloud-ml PREREQUISITE (owner clarification 2026-06-20): cloud-ml requires a CONTAINER REGISTRY created beforehand PLUS that registry's console-issued auth key (credential scr-auth-key) — this is why cloud-ml POST/GET 404 on a bare account. gen-cloudml-chain stands the registry up inline (/v1/container-registries create→show→delete); cloud-ml-write-coverage (coverage-only) does NOT, so for it the registry + scr-auth-key are EXTERNAL preconditions (the scr-auth-key credential is not a created resource, so it is documented here rather than listed as a prerequisite family). Canonical model: knowledge/formal/resources/ai-ml__cloud-ml.yaml (cloud-ml.requires: container-registry + {credential: scr-auth-key}).
